freeze.hash_scope: SHA-256 over the canonical JSON of this unit's model only, excluding this freeze block; a change to any other unit cannot move this digest
freeze.judge_dependency: none; no model or judge call was made by this build

constraints.expression: how far the restriction carries has to be recorded, because a constraint with unbounded scope will eventually be applied where the subject never intended it

provenance.evidence: 4091 of 4736 multi-service dialogues (86.4%) reuse a value across services: city 2238, location 1711, destination_city 1672, appointment_date 1058

item.sense: a restriction stated once and applying to later aims that never restate it

constraints.expression: at least three occasions, and a stated frequency is not one of them. 'I always cook on Sundays' is one observation of a claimed habit; two such claims are two claims, not two occasions

the support for this item is the weakest in O_L2: only 80 of 65245 MSC sentences state a frequency, and SGD recurrence is across dialogues by different users rather than repeated behaviour by one subject. It is admitted with a support floor of 3 because the alternative is to model recurrence as repeated l2:task, which would report every repeated action as a fresh unfinished aim

provenance.evidence: 80 of 65245 persona sentences state an explicit frequency ('usually', 'always', 'every day'); attested but rare, hence the support floor of 3
recurring service pairs across dialogues (Restaurants+Movies 247) show the co-occurrence shape, though not repetition by a single subject

item.sense: a behaviour a subject repeats on distinct occasions, evidenced by the repetitions

constraints.expression: a profile holds positive and negative entries at once; collapsing to positives loses the 970 dislike observations MSC attests

provenance.evidence: personas are authored as multi-sentence sets (65245 sentences overall) combining 13819 positive and 970 negative dispositions per subject

item.sense: the standing set of a subject's likes and dislikes in one area, with their conflicts kept

constraints.expression: at least two sub-aims that are not the same aim restated; one aim with two mentions is l2:task and calling it a project double-counts

provenance.evidence: 8266 two-service, 2185 three-service and 288 four-service dialogues; the recurring Flights+Hotels+Travel chain (163) is one outcome over three aims

item.sense: several tasks pursued under one outcome, where no single task achieves that outcome

constraints.expression: continuation is inferred, not observed, so an instance must remain distinguishable from a condition re-confirmed at the time of asking

provenance.evidence: 14288 ongoing-state persona sentences are asserted once and treated as holding for the whole conversation set without restatement

item.sense: a circumstance treated as continuing to hold until something is observed to end it

aliases: what they were trying to do

constraints.expression: a task needs the observation that declared it and at least one later observation bearing on whether it closed; a declaration alone is an L1 intention and does not become an L2 task by being remembered

provenance.evidence: an intent declared in one turn is satisfied several turns later via required_slots; INFORM_INTENT 3952 precedes NOTIFY_SUCCESS 1796

item.sense: one aim tracked across turns, from the moment it is declared until it closes or lapses

constraints.expression: the old value stays addressable: 'what did they say before' cannot be answered from the current value, and 71.6% of dialogues change one

provenance.evidence: 3661 of 5110 dialogues revise a user slot value; most-revised are city 571, departure_date 516, date 456, appointment_time 377

item.sense: the ordered series of values one attribute of one subject has taken, with the current one

constraints.expression: partial support must not be presented as complete support; this was the dominant observed shape and is the failure most likely to go unnoticed

provenance.evidence: 225 of 227 discovery observations were shaped partial_gold_overlap, against 1 empty_selection and 1 gold_delivery_over_limit

item.sense: an abstraction resting on some but not all of its expected supports must say so

constraints.expression: an abstraction with no addressable supports is rejected rather than reported with low confidence, matching the layer-gold rule that an abstraction with an empty derivation is malformed

provenance.evidence: L2GoldAbstraction in evaluation/layer_gold.py rejects an abstraction whose derived_from is empty, so this ontology must state the same requirement

item.sense: every abstraction must name the observations it rests on, individually and retrievably

provenance.evidence: NOTIFY_SUCCESS 1796 confirms a transactional intent completed

item.sense: evidence shows the abstraction's outcome was reached

constraints.expression: silence is not failure. Reporting a lapsed aim as abandoned asserts an outcome no observation supports, which is the more damaging error

provenance.evidence: 225 of 227 discovery observations were shaped partial_gold_overlap, meaning supporting evidence was partially retrieved; a status of unknown must be representable or partial support gets reported as a definite outcome

item.sense: no evidence of an ending and none of progress either, so the status is genuinely unknown

provenance.evidence: an intent with unfilled required_slots is live; SYSTEM REQUEST 5008 is the act of pursuing it

item.sense: the abstraction is live: evidence shows it started and none shows it ended

provenance.evidence: 71.6% of dialogues revise a value, and a revised aim is neither achieved nor abandoned; without this status one of the two would be asserted falsely

item.sense: the abstraction was replaced by a revised version of itself rather than ended

constraints.expression: a later restriction does not silently delete an earlier one; resolving the conflict is a decision with evidence, not a side effect of merging

provenance.evidence: 86.4% of 4736 multi-service dialogues reuse a value across services (city 2238, location 1711), so restrictions accumulate across sub-goals

item.sense: collect every restriction stated about one target and keep them all, including conflicts

constraints.expression: temporal adjacency is not decomposition; two adjacent sub-goals must share an outcome or the grouping is coincidence

provenance.evidence: 10739 of 16142 dialogues span 2-4 services, and the frequent chains (Flights+Hotels+Travel 163) share a single trip outcome

item.sense: group observations under a shared outcome that no one of them achieves alone

constraints.expression: two mentions of one occurrence are one observation, not two. Counting mentions instead of occasions inflates every frequency claim

provenance.evidence: SGD service pairs recur across dialogues (Restaurants+Movies 247, Homes+Calendar 235), so co-occurrence counts are measurable

item.sense: count how many separate observations instantiate the same type, over distinct occasions

constraints.expression: the series is not a set: reordering changes which value is current, so an implementation that collapses to the latest value has lost the item

provenance.evidence: 71.6% of 5110 dialogues revise a slot value at least once, so a series of two or more values for one attribute is the normal observation

item.sense: order observations about one subject and attribute by time, keeping the whole series

provenance.evidence: a value reused across 2 services in 86.4% of multi-service dialogues has a scope wider than the service it was first stated in

item.sense: how far an abstraction's applicability extends beyond the observations supporting it

constraints.expression: supports concerning different subjects do not aggregate; a profile built across subjects would attribute one person's preferences to another

provenance.evidence: tau-bench retail policy permits one user per conversation and requires denying requests about any other user, making subject identity a hard boundary

item.sense: the party an abstraction is about, which every supporting observation must concern

constraints.expression: two attributes revised in the same dialogue are two histories; SGD revises appointment_date and appointment_time independently

provenance.evidence: revision counts are per slot (city 571, departure_date 516), so a history is indexed by attribute and not by dialogue

item.sense: which single attribute a history is a history of
